page.overview:
Who is Kori Turbowitz?

Kori Turbowitz is a supporting character in Cars. She is a field reporter for the RSN Network. She is the racing world's roving reporter and she is at the scene of every major breaking news story. When something is about to happen, Kori gets her wheels in motion.

"The smoky-voiced Kori Turbowitz started her career off as a voicemail operator. But her delivery of "You have...THREE new messages" was spoken with such flair and irreverence that the next thing she knew, she was the number one radio host in the Bay Area, and one of the top Piston Cup reporters on television."

Kori appears four times in the film: first, interviewing Lightning McQueen after the Dinoco 400, then announcing his trailer's arrival in California, visiting Radiator Springs along with various members of the press after Doc Hudson called them and told where Lightning was and, lastly, near the winner's circle among a crowd of disappointed reporters looking at Chick Hicks.
